P201.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE title LIKE '%A%'

P202.sql: SELECT l.name,COUNT(f.film_id) FROM language l LEFT JOIN film f ON f.original_language_id=l.language_id GROUP BY l.language_id

P203.sql: SELECT a.actor_id,a.first_name,COUNT(DISTINCT fa.film_id) FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id=a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT fa.film_id) DESC,a.actor_id ASC LIMIT 4
